reply_schema.description: The current value. It never decreases but the same value can be returned more than once. Does not require an active transaction.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.summary: How the value is obtained. Case-insensitive.

arguments.name: fresh
arguments.summary: Fetches the latest value from the cluster. One round trip per call.

arguments.name: cached
arguments.summary: Serves the value from a node-local cache that may be up to one second behind. No cluster round trip.
